section.title: org.osgi.service.jakartars.whiteboard.propertytypes
section.para: Jakarta RESTful Web Services Whiteboard Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.

section.title: @JakartarsApplicationBase
section.para: Component Property Type for the osgi.jakartars.application.base service property.
This annotation can be used on a Jakarta RESTful Web Services whiteboard application service to declare the value of the JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_APPLICATION_BASE service property.

section.title: String value
section.para: Service property providing a base context URI for a Jakarta RESTful Web Services whiteboard application.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The base URI for this application.

section.title: String PREFIX_ = "osgi."
section.para: Prefix for the property name. This value is prepended to each property name.

section.title: @JakartarsApplicationSelect
section.para: Component Property Type for the osgi.jakartars.application.select service property.

This annotation can be used on a Jakarta RESTful Web Services whiteboard resource or extension service to declare the value of the JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_APPLICATION_SELECT service property.

section.title: String[] value
section.para: Service property providing a OSGi filter(s) identifying the application(s) to which this service should be bound.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The filter(s) for selecting the application(s) to bind to.

section.title: String PREFIX_ = "osgi."
section.para: Prefix for the property name. This value is prepended to each property name.

section.title: @JakartarsExtension
section.para: Component Property Type for the osgi.jakartars.extension service property.
This annotation can be used on a Jakarta RESTful Web Services extension service to declare the value of the JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_EXTENSION service property.

section.title: String PREFIX_ = "osgi."
section.para: Prefix for the property name. This value is prepended to each property name.

section.title: @JakartarsExtensionSelect
section.para: Component Property Type for the osgi.jakartars.extension.select service property.
This annotation can be used on a Jakarta RESTful Web Services whiteboard resource or extension to declare the value of the JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_EXTENSION_SELECT service property.

section.title: String[] value
section.para: Service property providing one or more OSGi filters identifying the extension(s) or application features which this service requires to work.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The filters for selecting the extensions to require.

section.title: String PREFIX_ = "osgi."
section.para: Prefix for the property name. This value is prepended to each property name.

section.title: @JakartarsMediaType
section.para: Component Property Type for the osgi.jakartars.media.type service property.
This annotation can be used on a Jakarta RESTful Web Services whiteboard extension or application to declare the value of the JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_MEDIA_TYPE service property.

section.title: String[] value
section.para: Service property identifying the name(s) of media types supported by this service.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The Jakarta RESTful Web Services media types supported.

section.title: String PREFIX_ = "osgi."
section.para: Prefix for the property name. This value is prepended to each property name.

section.title: @JakartarsName
section.para: Component Property Type for the osgi.jakartars.name service property.
This annotation can be used on a Jakarta RESTful Web Services whiteboard service to declare the value of the JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_NAME service property.

section.title: String value
section.para: Service property identifying the name of a Jakarta RESTful Web Services service for processing by the whiteboard.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The Jakarta RESTful Web Services whiteboard service name.

section.title: String PREFIX_ = "osgi."
section.para: Prefix for the property name. This value is prepended to each property name.

This annotation can be used on a Jakarta RESTful Web Services whiteboard resource to declare the value of the JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_RESOURCE service property.

section.title: String PREFIX_ = "osgi."
section.para: Prefix for the property name. This value is prepended to each property name.

section.title: @JakartarsWhiteboardTarget
section.para: Component Property Type for the osgi.jakartars.whiteboard.target service property.

This annotation can be used on a Jakarta RESTful Web Services whiteboard resource or extension service to declare the value of the JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_WHITEBOARD_TARGET service property.

section.title: String value
section.para: Service property providing an OSGi filter identifying the whiteboard(s) to which this service should be bound.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The filter for selecting the whiteboards to bind to.

section.title: String PREFIX_ = "osgi."
section.para: Prefix for the property name. This value is prepended to each property name.

section.title: @JSONRequired
section.para: Component Property Type for requiring JSON media type support using the JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_MEDIA_TYPE service property.

This annotation can be used on a Jakarta RESTful Web Services whiteboard resource to declare require that JSON support is available before the resource becomes active. It also adds an optional Requirement for a service providing this media type to aid with provisioning.

section.title: String osgi_jakartars_extension_select default "(osgi.jakartars.media.type=application/json)"
section.para: Provides an extension selection filter for an extension supporting the JSON media type

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A filter requiring an osgi.jakartars.media.type of application/json

section.title: String FILTER = "(osgi.jakartars.media.type=application/json)"
section.para: A filter requiring an osgi.jakartars.media.type of application/json
